<section class="fieldwork-index-section"><h2>방문지</h2><ul class="fieldwork-place-list"><li><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/sakya/"><strong>사캬 사원</strong></a> <span>— 티베트 · 짱</span></li></ul></section>
<section class="fieldwork-index-section"><h2>Carte</h2><div id="fieldwork-map" style="height:430px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin:1rem 0 2.5rem"></div></section>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" crossorigin=""></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){const m=L.map("fieldwork-map").setView([28.905,88.018],6);L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",{maxZoom:18,attribution:"&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"}).addTo(m);L.marker([28.905,88.018]).addTo(m).bindPopup('<strong>사캬 사원</strong><br>티베트 · 짱<br><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/sakya/">답사기 읽기</a>');});
</script>
